verdict.rationale: A probe confirms a live llms.txt at developer.sumup.com/llms.txt (HTTP 200) that links documentation sets, including llms-small.txt, which itself serves agent-readable content. First-party docs say every page is available as plain-text Markdown by appending index.md. They also explicitly position these resources as a way to give coding assistants current SumUp documentation, with an MCP server that exposes documentation tools.
